narrative.details:
I guess it doesn't feel quite right to keep calling you stranger after all of this so... thank you, adventurer.

If you wouldn't mind and are back out that way, please let Alvarion know what happened here. Also, tell him that once he's up on his feet he needs to bring a windshaper back here to look at that construct for us to make sure it's safe to have around our... our family.

<Aamelia touches her belly gently.>

He doesn't know about this part. Let's just keep that bit between us for now.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Alvarion Windfield in Valanaar.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Alvarion's eyes tear up as you finish retelling the story of what happened at the orchard.>I don't know how to thank you, friend. I came to Valanaar looking for hope. A vain hope, I was almost certain. But instead I found a hero. A real hero, like the stories from before we came to Skywall.I'll never forget what you did for us, Orsen. You'll always be welcome at the Windfield home.
